description: This file defines classes and constants for handling ASN.1 data structures, including Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes, with functions for encoding, decoding, and parsing ASN.1 data types.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A class for managing a byte buffer with reference counting and size management.

classes.name: OID
classes.description: A class representing an Object Identifier with parsing and text conversion capabilities.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: A class for handling ASN.1 sequences, including parsing and data access.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Set and get the size of the Buffer.

methods.name: Size()
methods.description: Returns the size of the Buffer.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access byte at a specific index in Buffer.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Const version of byte access in Buffer.

methods.name: Elements
methods.description: Returns an iterator over ASN.1 elements in an OID.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the OID.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns the raw buffer of the OID.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the OID.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next component.

methods.name: Number
methods.description: Returns the numeric value of the current OID component.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Counts the number of components in the OID.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the initial position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is at a valid position.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Extracts the ASN.1 value into provided variable, with overloads for different types.
